description: Create a review cadence (a monthly committee, a quarterly review, a weekly stand-up), or change one when cadence_id is given. Reviews are then scheduled with schedule_review and recorded with record_review. get_management_architecture lists the cadences and their ids. Fields not given are kept.

cadence_id.description: UUID of the cadence to change. Omit to create one.

frequency.description: How often it meets (required to create): get_agenda expects the next review from it

operational_level.description: Level it decides at (required to create)

parent_cadence_id.description: The cadence it reports to (a monthly committee under the quarterly review)

name: upsert_cadence
